title: Big update is live
subtitle: Apps, wallpapers, games, music, and the Extra tab
description:
Apps tab works again. YouTube, Spotify, Discord, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, Reddit, X, ChatGPT, Google apps, Netflix, Twitch, and more open inside Kobran with real icons on each card.

Settings has a new wallpaper section. Pick from featured backgrounds, search for hundreds of free wallpapers from across the web, or hit Surprise me for a random pick.

Custom backgrounds now have a dim overlay slider so text stays readable on bright images.

Game cards show star ratings so you can rate games and see what others liked.

Music player can show lyrics on screen. Turn them off anytime in settings if you do not want them.

Low data mode is in settings under performance. It trims heavy effects to save data and help weaker devices.

Install Kobran on your phone from settings for quick access from your home screen.

Game covers load faster and more games show thumbnails when you browse.

Extra tab has a cleaner layout with Home, API, and AI tabs across the top.

Loading screen is simpler and gets you in quicker.
